spec.situation_desc: had a loan application declined with no explanation

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Hannah speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’m Eilidh Pemberton. You’ve declined my loan application and given me no explanation. It’s really poor service, and I’m not happy with the bank at all.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been so frustrating, Eilidh. I’ll look into the application with you. Before I discuss any details, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, I’ve verified that. I can see the application was declined on the 18th of October, but I’m not able to see a specific reason here.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s exactly the problem. I spent ages filling everything in and then you just say no, with nothing to tell me why.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why that would be upsetting, and I’m sorry you’ve been left without an explanation. I’ll put a note on your account and ask our lending team to review what information they can provide.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send the request to the lending team today, and I’ll make sure it’s followed up. You’ll hear back within 5 working days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And who’s actually going to get back to me?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The lending team will contact you using the phone number we have on file. I’ll keep ownership of the request and check that it’s been sent over today.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I’m still really disappointed with how this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I do understand, Eilidh, and I’m sorry for the frustration. I’ve noted your concerns and sent the request to the lending team today; they’ll be in touch within 5 working days.
